compute_class_weight_balanced: compute class weights using balanced strategy for a given array of class labels
compute_class_weight_dict: compute class weights from a user-defined dictionary mapping labels to weight values
compute_sample_weight_balanced: compute per-sample weights using balanced strategy for imbalanced classification datasets
compute_sample_weight_subsample: compute sample weights for a subsample or bootstrap subset of training data
test_compute_class_weight_errors: test compute_class_weight and compute_sample_weight raise errors for invalid class_weight inputs
